subject: Literature
subcategory: The Art of the Short Story
title: Raymond Carver and Minimalism
description: Learn Raymond Carver and Minimalism in one minute.

hook.text: Raymond Carver wrote about working-class Americans in prose so stripped down it was called 'dirty realism.'

buildup.text: What We Talk About When We Talk About Love follows two couples drinking gin and failing to define love.

discovery.text: Carver's editor Gordon Lish cut his manuscripts by up to seventy percent, raising questions about true authorship.

twist.text: When Carver's unedited versions were published after his death, they revealed a very different, more expansive writer.

climax.text: The Carver controversy forced literature to ask where editing ends and co-authorship begins.

punchline.text: The king of minimalism may not have chosen minimalism.

quiz.question: What controversy surrounds Carver's minimalist style?
options: His editor cut manuscripts by up to seventy percent, raising authorship questions
